decisions.reason: Having survived the first review, this premium hand-knotted carpet likely meets aspiration levels sufficiently as a craftsmanship-led image product, so the firm is likely to retain it unless niche demand clearly weakens.

Because it is a low-pile decorative carpet in a crowded part of the portfolio and close to the already dropped Product A, it faces elevated rationalisation pressure, but its continued presence suggests results are not yet far enough below aspiration to force withdrawal.
The corner bench fits the core furniture and project business well, so boundedly rational management would likely see it as meeting internal aspirations and worth keeping.

This low-pile carpet remains somewhat exposed to pruning because of overlap with other recent carpet launches and the option to redirect resources, but absent visible underperformance organizational slack still favors continuation.
As a multi-model swivel shell chair line close to the firm’s main offer, it provides broad application, learning and project-business value, making continued support the most likely choice.
